phases.name: Universe Materialization, Identity Reconciliation & Reference Ownership
phases.note: R0.1 may not be executed as one undifferentiated task. Only its explicitly authorized sub-stage may be mutated; later sub-stages remain blocked until independent QA advances the queue.

subStages.name: Universe Semantic Materialization
subStages.objective: Mechanically materialize the existing governed Universe semantic content without changing its meaning or inventing missing identifiers.
scope: inspect both retained Universe HTML copies
record SHA-256 for each source HTML copy
extract all mechanically recoverable embedded data structures
perform a second deterministic extraction pass for structures that depend on previously declared variables where possible without semantic inference
preserve dual lineage: release shell Universe 7.3 and embedded semantic payload 7.2.0 unless evidence disproves that relationship
record extraction completeness and unresolved structures
compare normalized semantic payload produced from both HTML copies
add extractor/materialization tests and reproducibility hashes
requiredEvidence: semantic equality/difference result for the two source copies

subStages.name: Universe Release Identity & Authority Reconciliation
subStages.objective: Determine the authoritative relationship between Universe 7.3 release identity, embedded 7.2.0 semantic identity, and the two differing HTML source copies.
scope: determine whether HTML-copy differences are semantic, presentation, build-state or non-semantic noise
determine which source copy is authoritative or whether authority attaches to a normalized semantic payload rather than one HTML file
verify release notes/evidence for the 7.3 UX/foundation-over-7.2-semantics interpretation
define governed identity fields for releaseVersion and semanticPayloadVersion
recommend exactly what hashes/assets should be registered as canonical/frozen
excluded: renaming embedded 7.2.0 payload to 7.3 without evidence

subStages.name: Canonical Reference Ownership Audit
subStages.objective: Classify every unresolved Road LTL reference by its intended governing layer before deciding whether any Universe extension or crosswalk is required.
scope: inventory all unresolved Road LTL references previously treated as Universe canonical references
classify each reference as Universe canonical ID, Daughter-local structural ID, Operational Knowledge ID, Canonical Information/Object ID, cross-layer concept ID, or invalid/orphaned reference
determine whether a5-ltl-* identifiers are Daughter-local rather than Universe-canonical
determine intended ownership of scp-* identifiers from frozen architecture/contracts and retained evidence
identify whether the actual repair is Universe extension, governed crosswalk, reference-contract correction, or orphan cleanup
produce an owner-decision recommendation without mutating the reference model
subStages.requiredStatusLanguage: Use canonicalReferenceResolution=UNCLASSIFIED_PENDING_REFERENCE_OWNERSHIP_AUDIT until R0.1C is independently approved; do not represent 0/22 as 22 proven Universe defects before ownership is established.

exitGate: machine-readable Universe semantic payload is retained and reproducible
release/semantic identity and authority are explicitly governed
reference ownership is classified by layer
any true referential defects are distinguished from Daughter-local or cross-layer identifiers
independent QA approves the appropriate repair path before R0.2

phases.name: Road LTL Source Closure & Effective 1.5 Re-certification
Road LTL Operational Knowledge + Canonical Information Hardening
Generic Recursive Decomposition Compiler & Road LTL Re-certification
Ocean FCL/LCL 0.6 Operational Knowledge Depth Uplift
excluded: copying LTL knowledge to satisfy coverage

phases.name: Multi-Mode Decomposition Proof & Pre-P6 Readiness Certification
Canonical WorkDefinition Compilation
scope: resume only after R0.6 independent QA using re-certified decomposition inputs

phases.name: Former Generic Recursive Decomposition + Ocean Execution Depth
phases.note: Former scope is absorbed by R0.4-R0.6. Do not execute old P6.4 as written.

historicalFindings.description: Universe release 7.3 is not yet retained as a governed machine-readable semantic materialization. Embedded metadata self-declares semantic payload 7.2.0; two retained HTML copies differ in source hash and require authority reconciliation.
Previously unresolved a5-* and scp-* references must not be presumed to be missing Universe identifiers until governing-layer ownership is established in R0.1C.

Historical P6.1 generator is not retained and live protected payload is not readable by retained tooling; historical certification remains immutable evidence but is insufficient for reproducibility claims.
Ocean FCL/LCL 0.6 are below Road-LTL-equivalent Operational Knowledge/decomposition depth and cannot claim execution-depth parity before uplift.
